lines.zh: 我踩过草尖，脚爪先落地。
lines.en: My claws hit the ground before my weight does.

lines.zh: 我的黑羽在阳光下泛蓝。
lines.en: My black feathers shine blue in the sun.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在巡逻草原。
lines.en: I pace the plain like a patrol guard.

lines.zh: 头盔一样的骨冠晃来晃去。
lines.en: My helmet-like casque sways as I walk.

lines.zh: 别看我走路慢，踢腿很快。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my kick is quick.

lines.zh: 我沿着草丛边缘绕圈走。
lines.en: I circle along the edge of the tall grass.

lines.zh: 风把我的长脖子吹歪了。
lines.en: The wind bends my long blue neck.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，把石子踢到一边。
lines.en: I lift a foot and flick a pebble aside.

lines.zh: 每根羽毛都硬得像铁片。
lines.en: Each feather feels as stiff as an iron plate.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都压低。
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I pass.

lines.zh: 我低头看看自己的粗腿。
lines.en: I glance down at my thick legs.

lines.zh: 草原尽头有片树影，我去看看。
lines.en: There is shade at the plain's edge; I will check.

lines.zh: 我一步踩碎干枯的落叶。
lines.en: I crush dry leaves with a single step.
My shadow stands taller than the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块尖石头，不踩它。
lines.en: I step around a sharp stone rather than on it.

lines.zh: 草籽粘在腿上，走一步掉几颗。
lines.en: Seeds cling to my legs and drop with each step.
I tilt my head to hear bugs in the grass.

lines.zh: 骨冠蹭到树枝，咚了一声。
lines.en: My casque knocks a branch with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸得笔直晒太阳。
lines.en: I stretch my neck straight to sun it.
I shake my feathers and one drifts free.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: A deep rumble gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不长眼的狼。
lines.en: I am waiting for some careless wolf.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我刨出小坑。
lines.en: I scrape a small pit in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: I tidy the black feathers on my breast.
Cows call far away; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚缩进腹下暖着。
lines.en: I tuck one foot under my belly to warm it.
The sun makes my casque hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听，草原太安静了。
lines.en: I listen sideways; the plain is too quiet.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，脚趾想踢人。
lines.en: You stand too close; my toes itch to kick.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛盯着我的羽毛。
lines.en: Your eyes are fixed on my feathers.

lines.zh: 我歪头打量你手里的东西。
lines.en: I cock my head at your handful.
Have you come to take my plain?
My neck shoots out toward your face.

lines.zh: 你的气味像没洗过的皮甲。
lines.en: You smell like unwashed leather armor.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我有十层硬羽。
lines.en: I fear you not; my feathers are ten layers thick.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就前进半步。
lines.en: Back away, and I follow you in.

lines.zh: 你的影子投到我的脚爪上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my claws.

lines.zh: 我拿骨冠对着你，不眨眼。
lines.en: I level my casque at you without blinking.
That blow landed on my hard feathers.
My leg buckles and I nearly kneel.
You dared touch me; I will remember.
The pain makes my neck pull in.

lines.zh: 我的骨冠被敲得嗡嗡响。
lines.en: My casque rings from the hit.
My hard feathers took most of it.
You have angered an armored bird.
I back two steps, but not from fear.
Blood drips beside my claw.
I will return one kick; just wait.

lines.zh: 你手里红果子晃得我脖子痒。
lines.en: That red fruit makes my neck twitch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不是亲近你。
lines.en: I come closer, but not out of fondness.
Leave the fruit and back away.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不盯你的脸。
lines.en: My eyes stay on your hand alone.

lines.zh: 甜味飘过来，我脚爪发痒。
lines.en: The sweet smell makes my claws restless.
Come closer and I will peck once.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子闻了闻空气。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 你别以为我吃了就归你。
lines.en: Do not think feeding me makes me yours.
I snatch the fruit and turn away.

lines.zh: 有吃的就跟着，没吃的就散。
lines.en: I follow food, and leave when it ends.
Bump me once and your armor will dent.
I shove with my shoulder and push you off.
Your boot came down on my claw.
My feathers flare and make you back off.
Do not crowd me; the plain is wide.
My casque knocks against your knee.
Bump me again and my foot comes up.
I stand like a stone pillar; you stumble back.
This is only a warning, not a kick.
Make way; I am going for water.
I call softly from deep in the grass.

lines.zh: 另一只鹤鸵回了我一声。
lines.en: Another cassowary answers my call.
I circle it slowly, step by step.
My neck looks bluer than usual.
It pecks gently at my casque.
We stand side by side on the plain.

lines.zh: 我给它让出最软的草地。
lines.en: I give it the softest patch of grass.

lines.zh: 两只大鸟，脚步踩成一个点。
lines.en: Two big birds, stepping in one rhythm.

lines.zh: 风把我们羽毛吹到一块。
lines.en: The wind blows our feathers together.
I guard it and keep the wolves away.
I pick up the fruit and tip my head back.
This thing is hard; I bite it twice.
I carry a feather back to my grass nest.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我替你捡。
lines.en: You dropped it, so I scooped it up.
I carry it away; nobody gets to take it.

lines.zh: 喙里塞满了，我合不上嘴。
lines.en: My beak is full and will not close.
This fruit smells a little sour.
I bury it beneath the grass roots.
I drop the thing beside your feet.

lines.zh: 捡东西这事，我偶尔做一次。
lines.en: Picking things up is a rare favor from me.
A blade of grass twitches suddenly.

lines.zh: 那匹狼看我的眼神不对。
lines.en: That wolf is looking at me wrong.
I lower my head and grip the dirt.
I fix on it, neck pulled taut.
If it comes close, I kick it.

lines.zh: 我闻到血和湿毛的味道。
lines.en: I smell blood and wet fur.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸摇摇晃晃走过来。
lines.en: That zombie staggers toward me.

lines.zh: 我把骨冠对准它的方向。
lines.en: I aim my casque toward it.
One target only; do not mistake it.
I stride forward and snap the grass.
I close in step by step, silent.
It backs off; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My claw is already lifted.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀微微张开稳住。
lines.en: I spread my wings a little for balance.
It goes left; I was already waiting.
This kick will send it flying.
I lower my neck like a spear.
It pants; I do not even breathe hard.
The grass is too short to hide it.
I count my steps; three will do.
My foot slams into its chest.
The hooked claw tears through hide.
The kick flips it right over.
My beak stabs toward its face.
This kick lands as heavy as nine blows.
It hits a trunk and slides down.

lines.zh: 我的硬羽挡住了它的牙。
lines.en: My stiff feathers stop its teeth.
One more kick so it remembers.
Blood spatters across my black feathers.
Afterward I preen as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我从草原的晨雾里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the morning mist on the plain.
The grass is tall enough; I will stay.

lines.zh: 我把骨冠上的露水甩掉。
lines.en: I shake the dew off my casque.
My first step sinks into the soil.
Cows are far off; this spot is quiet.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里留下三道爪印。
lines.en: I leave three claw marks in the grass.

lines.zh: 风吹过，我的羽毛立起来。
lines.en: The wind rises and my feathers lift.
This plain is mine to patrol now.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看太阳的位置。
lines.en: I look up to mark the sun's place.
Whoever sees me first should step aside.
Fire singes my feathers; the stink is sharp.
I fall from a height and my legs go numb.
Water floods my beak and I kick wildly.
The blast rolls me over, ears ringing.
An arrow sticks in my feathers.
Purple light coils around my feet.
My belly is empty and pressed to bone.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，毛全立了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and my feathers stand.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，抓不住。
lines.en: The void drags me down and I cannot grip.
